questions.q: This sign is a warning sign indicating crosswinds.
When turning right from a one-way road, you must first move to the center of the road and proceed slowly.
questions.explanation: You must move to the right side of the road when turning right.

questions.q: This sign indicates a rotary (roundabout) ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign indicating two-way traffic.

questions.q: When a traffic officer raises their arm horizontally, traffic parallel to their body is treated as a red signal.
questions.explanation: Traffic parallel to the officer’s body is treated as a green signal.

questions.q: Large and ordinary motorcycles can tow a maximum of two vehicles at the same time.
questions.explanation: Only one vehicle can be towed at a time.

questions.q: This sign is a warning sign indicating a steep downhill slope.
When traveling on a priority road, it is possible to overtake automobiles or motorized bicycles at an intersection or within 30 meters before it.
Overtaking is prohibited on the left side of a safety zone and within 10 meters before or after it.
questions.explanation: Overtaking is allowed, but stopping or parking is prohibited.

questions.q: High-speed driving can cause the tire surface to peel off and burst, a phenomenon called the standing wave.
An ordinary motorcycle with a displacement of 125cc can travel on highways.
questions.explanation: Ordinary motorcycles with 125cc or less cannot travel on highways.

questions.q: This sign indicates that the road ahead is a priority road, and vehicles and trams must proceed slowly.
At a railway crossing with a traffic signal, even if the signal is green, you must stop temporarily to check for safety.
questions.explanation: You can proceed without stopping if the signal is green.

questions.q: When getting in or out of a vehicle, check the surroundings carefully, and in heavy traffic, exit from the left door.
With a large motorcycle license, you can drive an ordinary motorcycle.
Automatic motorcycles have strong engine braking, so it’s better not to overuse the front and rear brakes.
questions.explanation: Automatic motorcycles have weaker engine braking.

questions.q: This marking indicates the method for making a left turn at an intersection.
questions.explanation: This marking indicates the method for making a right turn.

questions.q: The distance from braking to stopping is always constant regardless of road conditions if the speed is the same.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance varies depending on road and tire conditions.

questions.q: When driving while fatigued, it takes longer to make judgments, resulting in a longer reaction distance.
An inner wheel difference occurs when a vehicle turns left but not when it turns right.
questions.explanation: An inner wheel difference occurs during both left and right turns.

questions.q: The center line is always located in the middle of the road.
questions.explanation: The center line is not always in the middle of the road.

questions.q: This sign indicates a railway crossing ahead.
When the battery fluid level is low, it should be topped up with distilled water.
Lights must be turned on when visibility is less than 50 meters, such as inside a tunnel.
On downhill slopes, speed increases and stopping distance becomes longer, so it’s better to keep a narrower gap with the vehicle ahead.
questions.explanation: A wider gap should be maintained with the vehicle ahead.

questions.q: When there is an obstacle ahead, oncoming traffic has priority, so you must stop or slow down to yield.
This marking indicates a prohibition on U-turns.
The maximum load capacity of a motorcycle is 50 kg.
questions.explanation: The maximum load capacity is 60 kg.

questions.q: Parking is prohibited within 5 meters of the entrance or exit of a parking lot or garage for vehicles.
questions.explanation: Parking is prohibited within 3 meters of such entrances or exits.

questions.q: At a railway crossing without a signal, you must stop temporarily and check safety with both eyes and ears.
Drivers who have held a license for less than one year must display a beginner mark on either the front or rear of the vehicle.
questions.explanation: The beginner mark must be displayed on both the front and rear of the vehicle.

questions.q: This sign indicates the type of vehicle, in this case, large passenger vehicles or specific medium passenger vehicles.
The braking distance is proportional to the reaction distance.
questions.explanation: Braking distance and reaction distance are calculated differently.

questions.q: When a person with a white or yellow cane is walking, vehicles must stop or slow down to allow safe passage.
When riding a motorized bicycle on a road with three or more lanes, it is best to use the middle lane.
questions.explanation: Motorized bicycles must use the leftmost lane.

questions.q: When the signal at an intersection ahead turns yellow, you may enter the intersection with caution even if you can stop safely.
questions.explanation: You may enter only if you cannot stop safely.

questions.q: This supplementary sign indicates the start of a traffic restriction zone or section specified by the main sign.
questions.explanation: This supplementary sign indicates the end of the restriction.

questions.q: When driving through a curve or corner, if the speed doubles, the centrifugal force also doubles.
questions.explanation: Centrifugal force is proportional to the square of the speed, so it increases approximately fourfold.

questions.q: When a police officer raises their arm vertically, traffic parallel to their body has the same meaning as a yellow signal.
When the signal ahead is flashing red, vehicles can proceed with caution to other traffic.
questions.explanation: Vehicles and trams must stop at the stop line.

questions.q: Self-centered driving not only inconveniences other vehicles but can also cause accidents, so it must be avoided.
This sign indicates that vehicles cannot pass through the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a sign indicating a T-shaped road intersection.

questions.q: When overtaking, you must first signal with the indicator, then check if the location is safe and confirm the surroundings.
questions.explanation: You must check safety first, then signal with the indicator.

questions.q: Unnecessary lane changes cause traffic disruptions and accidents, so they must be avoided.
When parking on flat ground, it is not necessary to engage the handbrake.
questions.explanation: The handbrake must always be engaged, even on flat ground.

questions.q: When a motorcycle negotiates a curve, it is best to gradually reduce speed while turning.
questions.explanation: Reduce speed sufficiently before entering the curve.

questions.q: This sign indicates the presence of a pedestrian crossing and a bicycle crossing lane.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign indicating a lane exclusively for pedestrians and bicycles; other vehicles cannot pass.

questions.q: It is better to drive at night with the interior light on.
questions.explanation: The interior light should be turned off while driving.

questions.q: This sign indicates that vehicles with a gross weight exceeding 5.5 tons cannot pass.
When a driver extends their arm diagonally downward out of the vehicle’s window, with the palm facing backward and moving the arm back and forth, it signals reversing.
While driving, focusing on a single point rather than maintaining a wide field of view makes it easier to predict hazards.
questions.explanation: A wider field of view makes it easier to predict hazards.
